description: Defines the UtilsVk class, a helper for Vulkan rendering utilities such as buffer and image operations, blitting, copying, and overlay rendering within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: UtilsVk
classes.description: A helper class providing Vulkan rendering utilities such as buffer/image operations, blitting, copying, and overlay rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases Vulkan resources associated with the UtilsVk instance.

methods.name: clearBuffer
methods.description: Clears a buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: convertIndexBuffer
methods.description: Converts an index buffer from one format to another.

methods.name: convertIndexIndirectBuffer
methods.description: Converts an indirect index buffer.

methods.name: convertLineLoopIndexIndirectBuffer
methods.description: Converts a line loop index indirect buffer.

methods.name: convertLineLoopArrayIndirectBuffer
methods.description: Converts a line loop array indirect buffer.

methods.name: convertVertexBuffer
methods.description: Converts a vertex buffer between formats.

methods.name: clearFramebuffer
methods.description: Clears a framebuffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: colorBlitResolve
methods.description: Performs color blit or resolve operation.

methods.name: depthStencilBlitResolve
methods.description: Performs depth/stencil blit or resolve.

methods.name: stencilBlitResolveNoShaderExport
methods.description: Performs stencil blit/resolve without shader export.

methods.name: copyImage
methods.description: Copies image data from source to destination.

methods.name: cullOverlayWidgets
methods.description: Performs culling of overlay widgets.

methods.name: drawOverlay
methods.description: Draws overlay UI elements.

methods.name: setupProgram
methods.description: Sets up graphics or compute pipeline for a specific rendering function.

methods.name: ensureResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes descriptor sets, layouts, and pools for a given function.

methods.name: ensureBufferClearResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for buffer clearing.

methods.name: ensureConvertIndexResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for index buffer conversion.

methods.name: ensureConvertIndexIndirectResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for indirect index buffer conversion.

methods.name: ensureConvertIndexIndirectLineLoopResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for line loop indirect index conversion.

methods.name: ensureConvertIndirectLineLoopResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for indirect line loop conversion.

methods.name: ensureConvertVertexResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for vertex buffer conversion.

methods.name: ensureImageClearResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for image clearing.

methods.name: ensureImageCopyResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for image copying.

methods.name: ensureBlitResolveResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for blit/resolve operations.

methods.name: ensureBlitResolveStencilNoExportResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for stencil blit/resolve without shader export.

methods.name: ensureOverlayCullResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for overlay culling.

methods.name: ensureOverlayDrawResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes resources for overlay drawing.

methods.name: ensureSamplersInitialized
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan samplers.

methods.name: startRenderPass
methods.description: Begins a Vulkan render pass.

methods.name: blitResolveImpl
methods.description: Performs blit or resolve operation depending on image type.

methods.name: allocateDescriptorSet
methods.description: Allocates a Vulkan descriptor set for a specific function.
